label: Controller Hook
description: Creates an action or filter callback with an ordered nested flow graph. Connect a Route to scope it, or leave it unconnected to register the hook globally.

properties.name: hook_type
properties.label: Hook type
properties.help: Actions run code. Filters receive a value and must return the value, optionally after changing it.

properties.name: hook_name
properties.label: Hook name
properties.help: Select a standard framework hook or type any custom hook name.

properties.name: data_variable
properties.label: Callback data variable
properties.help: PHP variable name for the value passed into the callback. Enter data or $data. Defaults to data.

properties.name: priority
properties.label: Fallback priority
properties.help: Used directly for unscoped hooks. When connected to a Route, top-to-bottom order generates route-specific priorities.
